paper_id: Wu et al. - 2017 - Mitigating Large Errors in WiFi-Based Indoor Localization for Smartphones
title: Mitigating Large Errors in WiFi-based Indoor Localization for Smartphones
motivation: WiFi指纹定位在大误差方面存在瓶颈，尤其在移动环境中现有方法性能迅速下降
problem_framing: 从物理约束和硬件限制出发，识别RSS指纹在空间和时间上的混合问题
key_insight: 移动用户采集的指纹是当前位与历史位的RSS混合体，需用幻影指纹匹配
method_signature: 幻影指纹+鲁棒回归+区分因子，统一指纹相似度度量
evaluation_criteria: 均值误差<3m，95分位误差<7m，对比现有方法提升21%以上
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 选择部分APs丢弃其他APs并非最佳方案，AP选择是数据依赖的
evidence_for_taste: large errors of prior works could range from 12 to around 40 meters
faraway APs may contain larger uncertainties
more than 11% of RSS measurements are outdated
over 80% of fingerprints contain outdated RSSs
thinking_moves: 从实测数据发现硬件协议导致的不完整扫描现象
将 Transitional fingerprint 定义为新问题类型
通过引入惯性传感器dead reckoning估计历史位置
用鲁棒回归(LMS)容忍小比例outlier的影响
